info.title: AtoA Customs & TARIC Resolution Gateway
info.description: High-performance deterministic gateway for HS6, NC8, and TARIC 10-digit customs classification. Designed for autonomous procurement, freight forwarding, and cross-border trade agents.

get.description: Returns status, latency and total active TARIC codes.
Performs sub-5ms BM25 full-text search against official French and English commodity descriptions.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Product keywords in English or French (e.g., 'lithium batteries', 'onduleur')

200.description: Ranked array of matching TARIC codes

get.description: Traverses the tariff tree using an HS6 pivot or exact TARIC 10 prefix.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Numeric code prefix (at least 2 digits, typically 6 digits for HS6 or 10 digits for TARIC)
